'''BG-12''' was a [[BG-series droid|BG-series]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. He was in the employ of [[Themog]], a criminal operating in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]].<ref name="HNNA" />
